blocks.title: Standard enthalpy change of reaction
blocks.text: Reaction ki standard enthalpy, delta Hr, woh enthalpy tabdeeli hai jab reactants ki stoichiometric miqdarein apni standard states mein standard halaat ke tehat poori tarah react kar ke products banayein.
Misal ke taur par hydrogen aur oxygen se pani ka ek mole: H2(g) + 1/2 O2(g) se H2O(l), delta Hr = -286 kJ fi mol.

blocks.prompt: Agar pani banne ka muadla dugna kar ke 2H2 + O2 se 2H2O likha jaye to delta Hr kya hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Yeh dugna ho kar -572 kJ hota hai, kyunke reaction ki enthalpy tabdeeli muadle mein likhi stoichiometric miqdaron ke liye hai; dugni miqdarein dugni hararat deti hain.

items: Delta Hr: standard halaat mein muadle ki stoichiometric miqdaron ke poori tarah react karne ki enthalpy tabdeeli; H2 + 1/2 O2 se H2O(l) -286 kJ fi mol hai.
